```tok
tok 1.0

pool restaurant "Restaurant" {
  lane guest "Guest" {
    task choose-wait          "Choose dish and wait"
    task place-order         "Place order with employee"
    task guest-appears       "Guest appears at service hatch"
    task guest-eat           "Guest eats meal"
  }

  lane employee "Employee" {
    task enter-order-pos     "Enter order into POS system"
    task collect-money       "Collect money from guest"
    task setup-buzzer        "Set up buzzer and pass to guest"
    task inform-chef         "Inform chef of new meal order"
    task set-buzzer          "Set off buzzer"
    task employee-call       "Call guest after 5 minutes"
    task employee-hand       "Hand over meal to guest"
  }

  lane chef "Chef" {
    task prepare-meal        "Prepare meal"
    task place-meal-hatch    "Place meal in service hatch"
    task inform-employee     "Inform employee that meal is ready"
  }

  lane pos "POS System" {
    // No explicit tasks; POS system is used by employee in the task above.
  }
}

start
end

xor guest-react "Guest reacts to buzzer?"

flow start               -> choose-wait
flow choose-wait         -> place-order
flow place-order         -> enter-order-pos
flow enter-order-pos     -> collect-money
flow collect-money       -> setup-buzzer
flow setup-buzzer        -> inform-chef
flow inform-chef         -> prepare-meal
flow prepare-meal        -> place-meal-hatch
flow place-meal-hatch    -> inform-employee
flow inform-employee     -> set-buzzer
flow set-buzzer          -> guest-react

flow guest-react -> employee-call "no"   when="react = false"
flow guest-react -> guest-appears       default

flow employee-call -> guest-react

flow guest-appears -> employee-hand
flow employee-hand -> guest-eat
flow guest-eat     -> end
```
